description: Permissions for the standalone git window's webview. Deliberately narrower than the main window's: this surface runs git operations and dialogs, but it never spawns child webviews (no browser tabs) and never writes app data, so the `core:webview:*` and `fs:*` grants are omitted. No `notification:*` permission appears here, and its absence is deliberate rather than an oversight: OS notifications are dispatched from Rust only (`src-tauri/src/notify`), because three windows share one origin and three webviews reacting to one `journal-appended` broadcast would produce three banners for one event. Granting a webview the capability would make that regression possible again, one `invoke` at a time. Grants `core:window:allow-destroy` alongside `allow-close`, and the pair is not redundant: `close()` only *requests* a close, and tauri prevents it outright for any window that has a JS `tauri://close-requested` listener — which this window has, because closing it is how it asks to be docked back. `onCloseRequested` then finishes the job with `destroy()`, so without this permission the window could not be closed at all, by the traffic light or by the workbench. See `close_satellite` in `src-tauri/src/window.rs`.
